snippet.title: Tick & Tired - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
PLAY THE FREE DEMO NOW ON STEAM! https://store.steampowered.com/app/5179950/Tick__Tired/

Tick & Tired is an incremental game about overcoming your to-do list. Complete short desktop tasks like sorting emails and organizing files, hire interns to automate the work and get massive combos at the end of the day to upgrade your workflow in a skill tree.
